import os
import sys


def main():
    with open("./data/sentence.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        text = f.read()

    words = text.split()
    lengths = {w: len(w) for w in set(words)}
    kept = [v for v in lengths.values() if v > 3]
    total = sum(kept)

    os.makedirs("./out", exist_ok=True)
    with open("./out/answer.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(str(total) + "\n")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
